notes:
I couldn't do this research, so I have no verse notes for you.

My research tools stopped working after only a few attempts. The first batch of page requests hit a usage limit and returned nothing. A single request for the Enduring Word page on Ezekiel 16 was then refused, because the tool only opens pages that have first turned up in a search. When I tried that search, I had no tool uses left. I never read a page from any of the approved sites.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, so I haven't written notes from memory or made up any URLs. There's nothing from the traditional commentators, the Protestant traditions, modern scholarship, Catholic or Orthodox sources, or popular modern teaching.

If you ask again in a new message, I'll start with searches so I can then open the main pages. Here is what I plan to read:
- **Verse by verse:** Enduring Word's chapter page for Ezekiel 16, and BibleHub's verse pages (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit Commentary and Benson) for each of vv. 43–63.
- **Key verses:** Got Questions on the sin of Sodom (vv. 49–50), and anything on the restoration of Sodom and Samaria (vv. 53–55, 61) and the "everlasting covenant" (v. 60). That includes Reformed views (Ligonier, The Gospel Coalition, Monergism) and Baptist ones (Desiring God, Spurgeon, GTY).
- **Other views:** NET Bible notes for the translation questions, and New Advent (Church Fathers) for Catholic readings.

To fit within the tool limits, it would also help to split the job into two parts: vv. 43–52 first, then vv. 53–63.
